<!--
How this page works
- The four ways in sit in a 2×2 grid (.involve-grid) right under the title, so
  all four fit on the first screen, on phones too. Each card: a title, one
  short line, a short button label (the title already says what it is).
- Email buttons: notebook.js fills in the address, subject and body from the
  data- attributes (see README). Without JavaScript, the address shows instead.
- The error-story wording under the grid was chosen with the IRB in mind; keep
  it word for word.
- Current openings: each opening is a .opening div. Give it data-until and
  notebook.js removes it from that moment on; with none left, the section
  says "No openings right now" by itself (.openings-empty, CSS only).
-->

## Media enquiries {#media-enquiries}

Journalists are welcome to write to the team.

<span class="email-obfuscate" data-user="contact" data-domain="productive-error.org" data-subject="Media enquiry: Productive Error" data-body="Outlet:|Deadline:|Question:" data-label="Email us" data-class="button button-secondary">contact [at] productive-error.org</span>

::::

::: {.email-note}
Error stories: writing to us starts a conversation, nothing more. We won't
quote, publish or use your story in our research without asking you first. If
it fits the project, we may invite you to an interview, which is voluntary and
confidential.

Keep me posted: a few emails a year, sent by Ryan. Reply "unsubscribe" any time.
:::
